title: Restore a spied method
summary: vi.spyOn watches an existing method. Restore it after the test so later code sees the normal method again.
introduction: vi.spyOn watches an existing method. Restore it after the test so later code sees the normal method again. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Restore a spied method

blocks.text: The spied method returns 9 during the test. Cleanup restores the original method.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what total returned before the spy.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Clearing recorded calls is not the same as restoring an original method.
For more detail later, use this [Vitest further reading](https://vitest.dev/guide/).
